worktree_snapshot.note: This differs from PASS 1: 17 tracked docs are now deleted in the worktree, 26 other tracked paths are modified, and untracked count has grown. These user changes were not reverted. The previous audit's 43-modified/540-untracked snapshot is stale.

classification_definition.DELETE: Unnecessary generated clutter or duplicate copy; a later cleanup pass may remove only after review/approval.
classification_definition.ARCHIVE: Historically meaningful research/development record to preserve outside active working paths or mark historical; do not discard.
classification_definition.KEEP: Current implementation, current research state, supporting code/data, or relocated current documentation.
classification_definition.HUMAN_REVIEW: Potentially consequential, user-modified/deleted, provenance-unclear, release/environment, or data-owner decision required.

classification_counts.count_basis: Each exact path listed in a group's paths array counts as one candidate. Directory entries count as one cleanup unit. Every path appears exactly once.

groups.reason: These are 150 exact-content copies in a 151-file set; they contain only the same feature/target names and estimator settings, not trained weights. No static reference to these exact timestamped paths was found. They were generated by ContinualTrainer, but their stored path is not persisted in the model registry. Removing copies would not change model behavior or 17.x experiment reproduction; it would discard their individual creation-time filenames.
groups.referenced_by_another_file: No exact timestamped path found by workspace search; writer generates names dynamically, and returned path is passed through the in-memory candidate/deploy result.
groups.imported_or_executed_by_code: No; JSON data snapshots, not code. No repository loader of the old timestamped files was found.
groups.loss_if_deleted: One generation timestamp/path per removed copy; payload is identical to the retained exemplar.

groups.reason: Generated listing/cache files or small one-off utilities whose output is reproducible from code/data retained elsewhere. Smoke-run JSON/CSV/JSONL are representations of a single CLI smoke run, not research outcomes.

groups.loss_if_deleted: Transient cache state, a stale directory listing, an ad-hoc printed result summary, and a reproducible smoke output.

candidate_model_snapshot_assessment.exemplar_note: Earliest filename timestamp selected solely as a stable archive representative; not an application-designated canonical model.
candidate_model_snapshot_assessment.writer: backend/ai/continual_trainer.py writes candidate_model_<UTC timestamp>.json via SequenceTransitionModel.to_dict().
candidate_model_snapshot_assessment.payload: feature_names, target_names, n_estimators, random_state; no fitted model weights.
candidate_model_snapshot_assessment.references: No exact historic filename references found in source/JSON; the writer returns a path in memory and DeployCandidate can forward that path. Registry stores model records but the inspected metadata snapshots are not named by the registry.
candidate_model_snapshot_assessment.timestamp_meaning: UTC file-generation second, weak provenance only; not an experiment ID, model version or coefficient lineage. It does distinguish creation attempts, so removing a path loses that timestamp record.
candidate_model_snapshot_assessment.classification_split: 150 duplicate copies DELETE candidates; the exemplar is ARCHIVE. All files remain untouched until human review/approval.
candidate_model_snapshot_assessment.safe_removal_assessment: In-repository model execution/research reproduction is not affected by duplicate payload removal, but timestamp provenance and potential external references cannot be guaranteed absent. Review before execution.

decision: CLASSIFICATION_ONLY. Do not execute DELETE/ARCHIVE actions until the user approves exact paths in a later pass.
